Vote - AcceptText - This text exists in three full copies (P.Mich. V 323, P.Mich. V 324, and PSI VIII 903) and one copy preserving the 1st and 3rd subscriptions (P.Mich. V 325). Only P.Mich. V 323 was published in full, with differences from the other copies selectively noted in the commentary. The corrections proposed here all concern the prototype, 323, and I can confirm that they are all correct after consulting the original. I also report the readings from the other Michigan copies.
line 5: Ἀραβαρχης → Ἀραβαραχης. This reading is found in 323, while 324 has Ἀραβάρχης.
line 26: τὰ δ’ ὁμολογημένα → τὰ διομολογημένα (l. διωμολογημένα). This reading is found in both 323 and 324.
line 29: τὸ → τὼι (l. τὸ). This reading appears in 323, 324, and 325.
line 29: Ἁρυώτης → Ἁρυώτη (l. Ἁρυώτης). Found in 323 and 324, while 325 has Ἁρυώτης Ἡρωδίωνος (omega for omicron).
line 32: τὸ → τὼ (l. τὸ). Found in 323, while 324 has τὸ.
line 32: προγεγραμμένον → πρωγεγραμμένον (l. προγεγραμμένον). Found in 323, while 324 has προ-.
line 34: τὸ → τοῦ. Yes, τοῦ is found in 323, 324, and 325.
line 35: τὸ → τὼ (l. τὸ). Found in 323 and 325, while 324 has τὸ.

Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Lin5 I too see Ἀραβαράχης on the pap. ; also lin26 διομολογημένα is clear ; lin29 τὼι (l. τὸ) I agree but would consider adding filler stroke at end of line ; lin29 Ἁρυώτης → Ἁρυώτη (l. Ἁρυώτης) OK ; lin31=> πωήσωι ; lin32 τὸ → τὼ (l. τὸ) OK ; lin32 πρωγεγραμμένον (l. προγεγραμμένον) OK . Lin34: τὸ → τοῦ I am not sure I agree; what Zellmann-Rohrer sees as the upsilon, the ed pr. took as the left side of a pi; the alpha, then, is somewhat awkwardly executed, and with a blot in it; but I don't see other T-shaped upsilons; so I think I'd be inclined to retain ed's <:τοῦ|reg|το:> ; lin35 τὼ (l. τὸ) OK.

Ἁρυώτης) line 32: τὸ → τὼ (l. τὸ) line 32: προγεγραμμένον → πρωγεγραμμένον (l. προγεγραμμένον) line 34: τὸ → τοῦ: the upsilon is in fact present line 35: τὸ → τὼ (l. τὸ)
